note: How the Storm Crossing Crew's return forecast (data/world/return_crossing.json) is laid on the level's real return route. scripts/world/crossing_sequence.gd reads this file. The forecast's 600 m route is stretched along the straight line from the Saltgate quay to the harbour mouth; its lanes are lateral offsets from that line (left and right as seen heading home). One forecast drives the hazards, the safe-lane signal and Arthur's calls, so they can never disagree.
spawn_note: The hazards are placed when the boat docks at the Saltgate, so the outbound crossing stays free practice and nothing pops into view mid-crossing.

near_miss.note: OUTBOUND_NEAR_MISS fires (repeatably) when the boat passes within edge_m of a sea stack's edge without touching it.

calls.note: Arthur's calls are dialogue lines whose trigger is the call id (ARTHUR_RET_01 ...), played when the boat's route position passes the call's trigger_route_m.

end_note: The forecast's 600 m ends here, 35 m south of the island's rim at the harbour mouth, so no hazard lands on the island or in the harbour; the boat's own docking takes it the rest of the way (RETURN_ARRIVED).
